verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a fiat-to-crypto payments platform (widgets, SDKs, APIs), not an AI agent or host application that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence only shows MoonPay serving a docs MCP server to other agents, which is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
